## Context
Mary's published background includes dual master's degrees, leadership of an intensive outpatient chemical dependency treatment center, and more than 25 years of experience. Her approach combines personal conversations, reflection, and practical action. Some portraits on this site are AI-created using reference photos of Mary. Coaching descriptions are not guarantees of outcomes. Pricing includes a client-directed $99 introductory hour plus Starter ($249), Professional ($399), Expert ($499), and Premium ($549) plans; exact inclusions, service location, session format, and availability should be confirmed directly with Mary. This file is an optional discovery aid, not an indexing requirement.
